cohort: 1,139 children aged <10 years in Acrelândia, western Brazilian Amazon
finding: Overweight was more prevalent than stunting in this population of children, and was associated with factors such as higher household wealth, maternal overweight, caesarean delivery, high birth weight, micronutrient deficiencies, and high TAG concentration.
mod_finding: Caesarean delivery was positively associated with overweight in children <5 years of age.
